text:
maya: Heads up — noticed a couple of PRs where the eval CI never ran (no artifacts, no report). happened on #PRs 4121 and 4130.

jorge: ugh. any commonalities? changed files / labels?

maya: both touched model/quant and evals/config.yml. GH Actions UI shows the workflow as "skipped" with reason 'no matching event' even though the PR updated files.

sylvie: can you paste the workflow header? might be a path filter or only running on push to main.

maya: pasted snippet —
```yaml
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - 'models/**'
      - 'deploy/**'
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 6 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch: {}
```

maya: looks like we never added pull_request to the triggers (facepalm). the push/paths combo explains a lot.

jorge: that would do it. but iirc we intentionally limited PR triggers because of the eval matrix exploding for every tiny PR.

nate: right — previous PRs flooded the runners so we added path filters on push. but we still need a PR gating path. possible options:
- add pull_request but narrow the matrix for PRs
- keep GH Actions schedule for nightly & PR-lite run via buildkite
- have a small lightweight GH Action that triggers the heavy eval pipeline in buildkite only for PRs that touch eval-relevant paths

sylvie: my vote is: keep heavy runners off GH Actions for PRs, but ensure there's at least a smoke eval on PRs (fast metrics) and a full run on merge. We should wire a PR-trigger that runs a reduced matrix (shorter sequences, subset of benchmarks).

maya: agree. also saw the buildkite side had some odd cancellations. buildkite bot: "buildkite: triggered pipeline evals/pr-smoke for commit abc123 but no agents claimed the job; queued for 27m"

eval-runner-bot: "queue-length: 9; pool: shared-eval; last-agent-heartbeat: 2025-11-02T08:41:12Z"

nate: that's the other piece — runner pool pressure. current autoscale config has a weird cooldown that prevents burst-up for PRs. we should create a dedicated small pool for pr-smoke (pr-eval-small) with less cool-down.

jorge: concrete plan proposal:
1) update .github/workflows/evals.yml to add a pull_request trigger but guard matrix with an if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' -> use matrix: [short-benchmarks]
2) add a lightweight GH Action job (runs in ~6m) that triggers buildkite full-eval pipeline via API for PRs labeled "run-evals" or when changes in evals/ or models/ are detected
3) provision a dedicated buildkite pool pr-eval-small with autoscale params: min=0, max=3, scale_up_cooldown=15s, scale_down=5m
4) add jitter to nightly cron to spread load (randomized minute)

sylvie: for (1) please use explicit pull_request types: [opened, synchronize, reopened] to avoid weird triggers. also don't call pull_request_target (security).

maya: on (2) — we can implement a tiny GH action that posts to Buildkite using a PAT pinned to the integration account. sample curl: 
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.buildkite.com/v2/organizations/redwood/pipelines/full-evals/builds" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $BUILDKITE_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"commit":"$GITHUB_SHA","branch":"$GITHUB_REF","message":"PR $PR_NUMBER - triggered by GH Action"}'
```

nate: +1. also add a safeguard: only trigger full-eval if changed files intersect with a precomputed list (models/, evals/, human-evals/). use actions/changed-files or a small script to diff the PR.

maya: small gotcha — GH Actions scheduled workflow runs are counted against concurrency and can cancel in-progress runs due to the concurrency: group. i traced cancellations to this block:
```yaml
concurrency:
  group: "evals-${{ github.ref }}"
  cancel-in-progress: true
```
we should set cancel-in-progress: false for nightly and for pr-smoke.

jorge: good catch. makes sense to avoid the schedule stomping a running manual or PR job.

sylvie: Also, re: metrics — PR smoke should compute a tiny set: perplexity on 3 shards, generate latency p95, and a binary safety flag check. full eval doors compute the full suite. we should codify metric names in evals/config.yml to ensure dashboard mapping doesn't break.

maya: adding to action items:
- PR: add pull_request trigger + PR matrix reduction (maya) — target EOD
- PR: gh action -> buildkite trigger script + path diff check (jorge) — target tomorrow
- Infra: provision pr-eval-small pool + tweak autoscale cooldown (nate) — target this week
- Ops: set concurrency.cancel-in-progress false for schedule (sylvie) — target today

ci-bot: scheduled task created: #task-ev-ci-1981 assigned -> maya, jorge, nate, sylvie.deadline 2025-11-08

maya: i'll open the PR for the workflow change and add the smoke matrix. pushing draft now.

jorge: i'll start the buildkite trigger action and test on a sandbox repo first.

nate: i'll ramp up the pool and add a short autoscale policy; will report agent metrics after changes.

sylvie: once PRs start getting smoke runs, let's add a small dashboard panel for 'PR smoke pass rate' and alert if <70% over a day.

maya: thanks all. :thumbsup: will follow up with links to PRs + infra tickets.

ci-bot: buildkite: pipeline full-evals/PR-smoke started (build 8912) — agent assigned: pr-eval-01

eval-runner-bot: build 8912 status: running; stage: setup; ETA: ~5m

maya: seeing the smoke job run on that PR now — looks good. closing the immediate incident.
